IN.one_line: Buy THELEELA.NS cautiously; strong momentum leads, but the stock is already stretched.
reasons: The hotel company recently reported much better earnings than expected.
Its share price has already risen a lot, so a fall is also possible.
Charges and short-term tax mean a small gain may not beat the market.
good_news: The stock gained 20.55% in one month and 29.79% in three months.
Trading volume was 1.54 times its 20-day average.
bad_news: The stock is 35.02% above its 200-day average.
Its RSI is 69.9 and it is at its 52-week high.
Latest quarterly revenue was down 17.1% year over year.

Its business results look strong compared with its current valuation.
